meta.title: 宠物 AI 管家：活体系统与日常仪式感
meta.subtitle: Mobile interaction mood board for a warm, trustworthy pet-care AI workspace
meta.brief: 为 AI 对话、宠物档案、健康日志、日常打卡、就医准备设计更有新意的移动端交互与视觉体验。
meta.audience: 猫狗主人、多宠家庭、重视健康记录和 AI 辅助决策的用户。
constraints: 核心隐喻：活体宠物系统
视觉语言：日常仪式感、成长记忆档案
避免幼稚卡通、后台面板、恐慌医疗
每张图是单一视觉参考，不是 mini mood board

items.title: Living Pulse Home
items.caption: 首页像一套会呼吸的宠物生命系统，状态由细腻波形和温度色表达。
items.source: Generated from Pet AI Manager brief.
items.motif: breathing biometric line, pet care home screen, soft morning light
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a premium mobile pet care app home screen on a phone, the interface feels like a living pet operating system with a subtle breathing biometric line, warm off-white surfaces, amber and sage status glow, compact pet identity area, no readable text, no logos, no charts, no desktop dashboard, elegant iOS-quality UI, practical and emotionally warm, not childish.

items.title: Care Constellation
items.caption: 健康日志从时间线变成关系星图，记录之间被 AI 串成可理解的照护轨迹。
items.source: Generated from Pet AI Manager brief.
items.motif: constellation of care events, warm archive, relationship map
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a mobile app screen showing a pet care constellation, small glowing nodes connected by gentle lines representing feeding, symptoms, medication, walks, and AI advice, dark warm green night background with cream and amber points, cinematic but usable app UI, no readable labels, no logo, no collage, not sci-fi blue-purple, not a dashboard.

items.title: Symptom Clue Board
items.caption: AI 对话在异常场景下变成线索板，把症状、饮食、精神状态和风险信号分层。
items.source: Generated from Pet AI Manager brief.
items.motif: clinical clue cards, AI reasoning, calm investigation
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a mobile AI chat interface transformed into a calm symptom investigation board, layered clue cards with abstract icons and timeline dots, warm clinic lighting, clear hierarchy, no readable text, no red emergency panic, no detective cliches, no corkboard, no collage, elegant pet health assistant UI.

items.title: Vet Briefing Capsule
items.caption: 就医准备像一个冷静简报舱，帮助主人把混乱信息整理成兽医可读结构。
items.source: Generated from Pet AI Manager brief.
items.motif: quiet medical briefing, export-ready summary, structured calm
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a mobile veterinary briefing mode, a clean phone screen with calm white and blue-green panels, structured summary blocks, attachment chips, and a soft status rail, no readable words, no hospital fear, no red alert styling, no dashboard density, premium clinical mobile UI for pet owners.

items.title: Daily Care Orbit
items.caption: 喂饭、喝水、便便、散步、用药围成日常轨道，形成轻仪式而非机械打勾。
items.source: Generated from Pet AI Manager brief.
items.motif: care orbit, daily routine, small pet avatar path
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a mobile daily pet care ritual screen, compact orbit path with abstract care icons for meals, water, bathroom, walk, medication, a small pet avatar marker moving along the orbit, warm cream background, tactile mobile UI, no readable labels, no gamified childish cartoon, no oversized cards.

items.title: Memory Archive Ribbon
items.caption: 成长档案不是相册，而是一条可回看的照护记忆丝带。
items.source: Generated from Pet AI Manager brief.
items.motif: timeline ribbon, health memories, monthly pet archive
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a mobile pet growth memory archive, an elegant vertical ribbon of abstract photo thumbnails, health moments, soft paper texture, small status beads, warm archive aesthetic, no readable text, no scrapbook collage, no cute stickers, no social media feed look.

items.title: Food Bowl Calibrator
items.caption: 喂养计划变成可调节饭碗刻度，主粮和零食预算被直观看见。
items.source: Generated from Pet AI Manager brief.
items.motif: interactive bowl gauge, feeding plan, portion ritual
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a mobile feeding plan interface centered on an elegant bowl-shaped gauge, kibble amount indicated by subtle fill level, small sliders and chips around it, warm tactile materials, no readable numbers or text, no brand packaging, no cartoon bowl mascot, polished pet nutrition app UI.

items.title: Stool Spectrum
items.caption: 便便记录被抽象成色谱和形态点，实用但不尴尬。
items.source: Generated from Pet AI Manager brief.
items.motif: digestive spectrum, abstract color analysis, health logging
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a discreet mobile pet digestive health logging screen, abstract color spectrum beads and soft shape indicators, photo analysis implied without showing explicit stool, warm scientific design, no readable text, no gross realism, no medical panic, no dashboard table.

items.title: Multi-Pet Family Orbits
items.caption: 多宠家庭不是切头像，而是每只宠物拥有自己的照护轨道。
items.source: Generated from Pet AI Manager brief.
items.motif: family orbit system, multiple pets, parallel care routines
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a mobile multi-pet household screen, three gentle orbit lanes with distinct pet avatar silhouettes and tiny care task markers, warm organized composition, app-like and compact, no readable text, no childish characters, no cluttered dashboard, no social feed.

items.title: Emotion Light Field
items.caption: 情绪记录用光场表达活跃、疲惫、放松、紧张、亲近、躲避等细微变化。
items.source: Generated from Pet AI Manager brief.
items.motif: behavioral mood field, soft dots, pet emotion tracking
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a mobile pet behavior and emotion tracking screen, a soft two-dimensional light field with a movable glowing point and calm pet silhouette, subtle gradients in amber, sage, and muted blue, no readable axis labels, no childish mood faces, no psychology dashboard.

items.title: AI Care Companion
items.caption: AI 不是医生头像，而是界面里的安静陪护智能，随场景改变回复形态。
items.source: Generated from Pet AI Manager brief.
items.motif: adaptive AI chat, companion presence, pet-safe reasoning
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of an immersive mobile AI pet care chat, messages softly transform into compact care cards and next-step action chips, a subtle ambient assistant presence without a face or mascot, warm premium UI, no readable text, no chatbot cliches, no doctor avatar, no desktop panels.

items.title: Recovery Garden
items.caption: 观察、恢复、复诊这些状态像一座慢慢变健康的护理花园。
items.source: Generated from Pet AI Manager brief.
items.motif: recovery garden, care status, living system
items.prompt: Single visual reference image of a mobile pet recovery tracking screen inspired by a quiet care garden, tiny abstract sprouts represent completed observations and medication moments, soft biomorphic cards, warm natural lighting, no readable text, no childish game garden, no fantasy style, no alarming medical cues.
